name: Runner Extras - Query Over Dependency Table
brief: Issue #2295: a source-defined Query whose dataitem is a table from a dependency app (Base Application Item) was built with NCLMetaQuery=NULL, so SetRange() and Open() threw NullReferenceException.
description: The symbol reference for a Query dataitem bound to a table from another module carries a module-qualified RelatedTable ('#<appId>#Item'). BcAppSymbolCache.TryParseQueryDataItem kept the qualifier, so RecordPatches.ResolveTableIdByName could not resolve the table, BuildMetaQueryDesign gave up, and the Query ran with no metadata. Report dataitems already strip that qualifier; this suite proves Query dataitems do too, end to end: Open/Read over Item, SetRange narrowing to one row, and an application-local Query as the control arm. The runner-specific half (the symbol-cache parse and the CacheVersion bump) is covered in AlRunner.Tests/BcAppSymbolCacheQueryDataItemQualifierTests.cs. The plain-BC claim (a Query over Item opens and reads) was verified on a real service tier in the issue and belongs upstream in the corpus.
